question: The registered list prefix-brokers names 'anyip'. anyip.com (Seven Digital Network Services LLC) leases RIPE PA /24s from US$ 189 a month; anyip.io is a different company that sells mobile and residential proxies by the gigabyte (the page read lists plans from 'As Low As $2 Per GB'). Should the list's note name the domain, and should anyip.io get its own ip-proxy record from a separate unit?
why: The name alone matches two unrelated vendors; only anyip.com is a prefix broker, and this unit proposed a record for it only.
